name: Viterskalet-Hemavan
to: Hemavan, Kungsledens sodra entre / Naturum Vindelfjallen
estimatedTime: 3-4 hours by STF; 4-5 hours by Naturkartan/Lansstyrelsen
difficulty: No formal official grade found. Naturkartan describes the section as easy hiking; practical difficulty is easy-to-moderate mountain walking because of open fell, snow-season/currentness, reindeer sensitivity, route-choice ambiguity near Hemavan and the descent through the ski-area/ravine approach.
routeType: point-to-point final Kungsleden mountain hiking section from the Viterskalet hut area to the official southern gateway at Naturum Vindelfjallen in Hemavan; Hemavan village/E12 bus stops are access points rather than the route endpoint.

officialSources.name: STF Ammarnas-Hemavan route group
officialSources.evidence: Lists Etapp 6: Viterskalet-Hemavan as 10 km and 3-4 hours. Describes walking southwest from Viterskalet between Vastra Syterbacken and Sodra Sytertoppens spur, then toward Hemavan ski area, where several route choices exist and most hikers take the longer route ending at Hemavans Naturum, Kungsleden's southern entrance.

campingAndFire.summary: No section-specific camping ban was found, but the section lies in/near Vindelfjallen and reindeer-sensitive mountain terrain. Dispersed low-impact camping appears possible away from hut/service areas, while hut-adjacent camping may be controlled/fee-based if using STF services. Fire restrictions are dynamic and must be checked live.
camping: Field reports mention camping 1-2 km beyond Viterskalet and hut staff directing campers farther away from the hut area.
No separate official dedicated tent-site point was confirmed for the section.
STF hut service/tent-fee policy may apply if campers use hut services or camp in hut areas; verify current STF policy before import/publication.
Avoid camping or lingering in ways that disturb reindeer, especially during spring movement/calving sensitivity.
fire: No permanent section-specific fire ban was found.
Fire bans are dynamic through municipality/Lansstyrelsen/SMHI/Krisinformation and must be refreshed the same day.
Hemavan Vacker Utsikt has a fireplace/benches according to Naturkartan; bring own firewood and do not collect/damage vegetation.
Vindelfjallen/protected-area rules prohibit damaging vegetation/wood; model fire as currentness-controlled metadata, not always-allowed.

seasonality: Naturkartan/Vindelfjallen says snow often remains long on Viterskalsstugan-Hemavan and hiking is usually not possible until earliest after Midsummer.
For 2026, STF Viterskalet staffed/open periods found in research were 2026-02-27 to 2026-05-03 and 2026-06-18 to 2026-09-20; verify before public use.
Naturum Hemavan spring season ended 2026-04-29 and summer reopening was listed as 2026-06-22; the physical trailhead/parking exists outside visitor-centre hours.
dogsReindeerLivestock: Naturvardsverket general rule: dogs must be under extra control 1 March-20 August.
The area is reindeer husbandry terrain; STF explicitly asks hikers to show consideration. Spring reindeer movement/calving sensitivity was flagged by Lansstyrelsen for April-May/into June contexts.
Keep dogs leashed/under close control and give reindeer/herds wide space.
weatherNavigationAndTerrain: Although the official final stage is relatively short/easy in summer, it starts on open fell and can be affected by snow, fog, wind, water level and poor visibility.
Winter red-cross routes and summer route markings can be confused near Hemavan; follow summer Kungsleden line, map and signs.

STF notes several route choices after Hemavan ski area. Most hikers take the longer route to Naturum, Kungsleden's southern entrance; summer lift/gondola options are access shortcuts, not official section geometry.

Hunting/fishing rules are area/season/license dependent and were not normalized into section facilities.
SMHI warnings and Lansstyrelsen fire-ban/current notices should be refreshed before publication.

findings: Naturkartan public .gpx for the section returned HTTP 200 with 4653 bytes and 65 points, but is reverse-direction and lower-density; .geojson returned HTTP 404.
Naturvardsverket AC3 clipped at vertex 208 is the strongest master geometry candidate because it is official state-trail data with <=20 m quality and a clear route-line terminus at Hemavan/Naturum.
Hemavan E12/village bus stops are access points and should not override the route-line endpoint at the Naturum/Kungsleden southern entrance.
Viterskalet subfacilities and Hemavan endpoint services need duplicate/end-cluster handling; AC9/AC10/Fjallfinakatan side-route features should be suppressed from the main section.
researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Ready for normalization with caveats. Remaining work is runtime import policy, endpoint snapping, live-currentness refresh and taxonomy decisions rather than missing research.
